expr: (() => { const c=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); return c.indexOf('canvas')<c.indexOf('controls') && c.indexOf('controls')<c.indexOf('readout') && b.length===2 && b[0].includes('10 kertaa enemmän') && b[1].includes('10 kertaa vähemmän') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: DOM order canvas, controls, readout; two buttons; nothing animates, so no speed control
